name: Błażej Dubiel
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable applications across diverse domains. Driven to turn unknowns into efficient solutions. Currently pursuing a career in AI, eager to contribute to impactful projects in the field.

bullets: Designed and developed successfully the control software for the prototype of a clarifier machine in the chemical lab of a beet sugar factory, used to maintain chemical solutions for specific concentrations. Built the front-end and back-end on a Raspberry Pi.
Developingand and maintaining track and trace software infrastructure for automation of track and trace solutions to ensure compliance and operational efficiency within EU tobacco directive.
Developed and implemented end-to-end industrial machine software, spanning control logic, HMI development, data collection and processing applications and visualization dashboards.
Configuring and optimizing vision systems for object detection and classification tasks in the automated pipelines, ensuring nearly perfect system accuracy.
Responsible for Claude Code adaptation within the software team, including research, infrastructure set up, skills and routines design.
Daily collaboration with cross-functional teams, including engineers, product managers as well as customers.
Conducted research as part of a project entitled “Autonomous Detection and Classification of Bituminous Joints in Highway Pavement Using Two-Staged and Residual-Based Convolutional Autoencoder.

Extracted and preprocessed intensity-based data from a laser-triangulation system and developed an end-to-end unsupervised pipeline for bituminous joint detection, addressing label sparsity, anomaly detection, feature space inhomogeneity, and normalization challenges.
Thesis outcomes received high acclaim, earning a grade of 7.5 from academia and recognition from the host company, where the proposed approach established a benchmark for future projects.
